key_highlights: ASX shed $90bn in a week as rate-rise fears and oil price surge pressured miners and banks
Iron ore entering a 'bloodletting' phase, pressuring BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX
AUD weakened sharply on growth scare; fuel prices set to rise 30c/litre
US CPI at 3.4% (Aug) kept inflation sticky, raising Fed hike odds and global bond yields
RBA flagged rental inflation as a key concern, complicating rate-cut timeline
Mining sector saw a wave of capital raises led by Canaccord, signalling cash stress
High-end Australian property prices hit steepest falls; affordable segment resilient
Tech/AI names (Oracle, SpaceX, HIVE) rallied globally on cloud demand outpacing supply
Australia softened local gas supply rules, easing Asian energy-security fears (Santos.AX relevant)
Superannuation reform debate intensified with populist pressure vs. institutional pushback

sectors.trend: Sharp negative. Iron ore 'bloodletting' underway; oil surge raises input costs. Canaccord-led cap raises signal sector-wide cash stress. Small-cap miners (PolarX, Sunstone, Manuka) saw relative outperformance.
sectors.implications: BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX face margin pressure from weak iron ore and higher energy costs. Gold miners (Kuniko, Gateway WA) benefit from safe-haven flows. Battery-tech (Critical Resources) offers diversification.

sectors.trend: Negative. Rising bond yields and rate fears pressured CBA.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX, WBC.AX. RBA rental-inflation concern delays rate-cut expectations, squeezing NIMs.
sectors.implications: Banks face a dual squeeze: higher funding costs and weaker credit growth. Housing correction (high-end) raises NPL risk. Defensive yield remains attractive but upside limited.

sectors.trend: Mixed-to-positive. Oil 'exploded' as price suppression failed; fuel prices to rise 30c. Australia softened gas supply rules, supporting Santos.AX and energy security narrative.
sectors.implications: Santos.AX, Woodside.AX benefit from gas policy easing. Higher oil is a cost headwind for transport and consumer sectors but positive for upstream producers.

sectors.trend: Positive globally. Oracle, SpaceX, HIVE rallied on AI cloud demand. ASX small-caps (Neurizon, Iondrive) saw relative strength.
sectors.implications: Limited ASX-listed pure-play AI exposure; indirect beneficiaries include CSL.AX (med-tech) and HIVE.AX. Global tech strength supports risk appetite selectively.

sectors.trend: Negative. Woolworths (WES.AX) breached its own 'Price Freeze' on four staples. Women's clothing chain closed 177 stores. Business confidence deteriorating.
sectors.implications: WES.AX, CSL.AX face margin pressure from input costs. Consumer discretionary under pressure. Staples remain defensive but growth is constrained.

sectors.trend: Negative. High-end property hit steepest falls; rental inflation keeps RBA cautious. RentTech regulatory tightening in Victoria. Migrant-driven demand a partial offset.
sectors.implications: Property REITs (e.g., SPRE.AX, VMC.AX) face cap-rate expansion risk. Residential correction may extend 6–12 months per Van Onselen. Migrant inflows support long-term absorption.

key_themes: Oil price surge and 30c fuel hike driving inflationary pressure across the economy
Iron ore structural weakness pressuring ASX 200 mining weights
AUD weakness amplifying import costs and complicating RBA policy
RBA caught between rental inflation and growth scare; rate-cut timeline pushed out
Mining sector capital raises signal liquidity stress and potential M&A activity
Housing correction concentrated in high-end; first-home-buyer surge supports affordability segment
Superannuation reform debate risks populist policy disruption
Chinese inflation surge and geopolitical tensions (Arctic shipping, India summit) add external risk
AI/tech cloud demand remains a global positive offset

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Oil price surge / fuel cost inflation
risk_assessment.mitigation: Hedge fuel exposure; favour upstream energy (Santos.AX, WDS.AX) over downstream/consumer; monitor OPEC+ output decisions
Reduce overweight in BHP.AX, FMG.AX; rotate into gold (Kuniko, Gateway WA) and battery metals (Critical Resources)

risk_assessment.risk_factor: RBA policy uncertainty / delayed rate cuts
risk_assessment.mitigation: Favour fixed-income ladders; avoid rate-sensitive REITs short-term; monitor rental data and RBA statements
Overweight domestic-revenue companies; underweight import-dependent retailers; monitor AUD/USD at 0.62 support
Avoid small-cap miners with imminent cap raises; favour cash-flow-positive majors or gold names
Diversify away from China-revenue exposure; monitor Chinese inflation and trade policy shifts
Monitor political messaging; favour diversified super fund managers; avoid single-theme super products

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight gold and battery-metal miners as safe-haven and structural growth plays
opportunities.rationale: Iron ore weakness and rate uncertainty support gold; battery tech (Critical Resources) benefits from energy transition

opportunities.recommendation: Add upstream energy exposure on oil surge and gas policy easing
opportunities.rationale: Oil 'exploded' on failed suppression; Australia softened gas rules supporting Santos and Woodside

opportunities.recommendation: Selective tech/AI exposure via ASX-listed enablers
opportunities.rationale: Global AI cloud demand outpacing supply; HIVE and Neurizon show momentum

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce overweight in iron ore majors; trim BHP.AX and FMG.AX
defensive_moves.rationale: Iron ore 'bloodletting' underway; $90bn ASX wipeout driven by mining and bank weakness

defensive_moves.recommendation: Underweight rate-sensitive REITs and high-end property exposure
defensive_moves.rationale: RBA rental-inflation concern delays cuts; high-end property seeing steepest falls

defensive_moves.recommendation: Increase cash / short-duration bonds as a hedge
defensive_moves.rationale: Sticky CPI (3.4%), rising yields, and AUD weakness create a volatile backdrop; preserve capital

defensive_moves.recommendation: Avoid Woolworths and consumer discretionary on margin pressure
defensive_moves.rationale: WES breached own price freeze; 30c fuel hike squeezes consumer spending; business confidence falling

market_outlook.short_term: Bearish-to-neutral. ASX likely to consolidate lower as oil-driven inflation, iron ore weakness, and delayed RBA cuts weigh on sentiment. $90bn weekly loss signals a risk-off regime. Watch for 10-yr bond yield direction and AUD/USD 0.62 support. Mining and banks remain the drag; gold and energy offer relative strength.
market_outlook.long_term: Cautiously constructive. Structural themes (energy transition, AI, gold) support selective opportunities. Housing correction may stabilise within 6–12 months. RBA likely to cut by H2 2027 once rental inflation eases. Superannuation reform, if managed well, could boost long-term savings flows. Key risk: prolonged oil shock or Chinese demand collapse.
